extraction.Name: Clara Bonser Monteau
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: Taxes, were the only things against the land.
extraction.Occupation/Income: My husband works for the railroad.
extraction.NOTES: Did not sign a receipt for the patent. Sold land for $2400.00, received in cash all at one time. Not satisfied with the sale; stated land was worth more. Did not apply for patent; patent was sent by mail. Six children, all living at home and all dependent on her. Subscribed and sworn before E. E. McKean, Superintendent, April 5, 1929.
